# arin_rdap_entity (Data Source)

Look up a public organization or POC entity by handle. No API key is sent. Returns contact fields and complete jCard/RDAP JSON, including embedded records and extensions. Public data may omit private registration fields. Partial results and referrals are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_entity" "example" {
  handle = "EXAMPLE-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Organization or POC handle.

### Read-Only

- `address_labels` (List of String) address labels returned by ARIN.
- `emails` (List of String) emails returned by ARIN.
- `entities` (Attributes List) entities returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entities))
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `kind` (String) kind returned by ARIN.
- `names` (List of String) Formatted names from jCard fn properties, sorted and deduplicated.
- `phones` (List of String) Telephone values as returned, including tel: URIs when used by ARIN. Parameters remain in vcard_json.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete RDAP response JSON, including nested entities, links, notices, remarks and extensions. Links are not followed.
- `roles` (List of String) roles returned by ARIN.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.
- `vcard_json` (String) Complete jCard JSON, preserving structured addresses, parameters, repeated properties and extensions. Null when omitted.

<a id="nestedatt--entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entities`

Read-Only:

- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `roles` (List of String) roles returned by ARIN.


<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) action returned by ARIN.
- `date` (String) date returned by ARIN.
